company_description: Infotel SA designs, develops, markets, and maintains software solutions in the areas of security, performance, and management in France, rest of Europe, and the United States. It operates through two segments, Software and Services. The company offers Arcsys, a secure archiving platform for electronic data; iDBA-Online, an intelligent management solution for administration and maintenance operations for DB2 databases; and Infoscope, a quality control software solution. It also provides InfoPak, InfoVic, and InfoUtil, as well as Orlando, a software solution for aircraft technical documentation; Deepeo, which offers a response to data protection; and utilities for Db2 for z/OS and LUW. In addition, the company offers consultancy, analysis, IT system audits, and third-party application maintenance services. It serves insurance, banking, public sector, services and utilities, industries, and transportation sectors. Infotel SA was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

description.long_fr: Infotel est une ESN française spécialisée dans les services informatiques sur grands systèmes, applications mobiles, big data, intelligence artificielle et logiciels propriétaires (édition). Le groupe sert grandes entreprises et administrations principalement en France. Chiffre d'affaires 2024 : ~310 M€.
description.long_en: Infotel is a French IT services company specialised in mainframe IT services, mobile applications, big data, artificial intelligence and proprietary software. The group serves large companies and administrations mainly in France. 2024 revenue: ~€310 m.
description.long_de: Infotel ist ein französisches IT‑Dienstleistungsunternehmen (ESN), das sich auf Großsysteme, mobile Anwendungen, Big Data, Künstliche Intelligenz und proprietäre Software (Eigenentwicklung) spezialisiert hat. Der Konzern bedient vorwiegend große Unternehmen und Behörden, hauptsächlich in Frankreich. Konzernumsatz 2024: ca. 310 Mio. €.
